examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shoulder_dance/shrug: A person walks slowly, stops and bounces both shoulders in a syncopated rhythm, walks again, stops and shrugs both shoulders once, then resumes walking with light movements.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shoulder_dance/sway: A person walks slowly, stops and bounces both shoulders in a steady rhythm, walks again, stops and sways the hips right and back once, then resumes walking with light movements.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shoulder_dance/wave: A person walks slowly, stops and bounces both shoulders in a syncopated rhythm, walks again, stops and waves the right hand once, then resumes walking with a loose posture.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shoulder_roll: A person walks slowly, stops and rolls both shoulders once, then resumes walking with a loose posture.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shoulder_roll/clap: A person walks slowly, stops and rolls both shoulders once, walks again, stops and claps both hands once, then resumes walking with a loose posture.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shrug: A person walks slowly, stops and shrugs both shoulders once, then resumes walking with controlled motion.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:shrug/wave: A person walks slowly, stops and shrugs both shoulders once, walks again, stops and waves the left hand once, then resumes walking.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:squat: A person walks briskly, stops and squats once and straightens up, then resumes walking with a stiff posture.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:stop_sign: A person walks slowly, stops and holds the right palm forward, then lowers it, then resumes walking with controlled motion.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:stop_sign/chest_touch: A person walks slowly, stops and holds the right palm forward, then lowers it, walks again, stops and touches the chest with the right hand, then resumes walking carefully.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:sway/head_shake: A person walks slowly, stops and sways the hips right and back once, walks again, stops and shakes the head once, then resumes walking with relaxed shoulders.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:sway/nod: A person walks slowly, stops and sways the hips right and back once, walks again, stops and nods the head once, then resumes walking carefully.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:wave: A person walks slowly, stops and waves the left hand once, then resumes walking with controlled motion.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:weight_shift: A person walks slowly, stops and shifts weight onto the left foot and back, then resumes walking with controlled motion.
examples_by_program.locomotion:walk:weight_shift/nod: A person walks steadily, stops and shifts weight onto the right foot and back, walks again, stops and nods the head once, then resumes walking with a stiff posture.

policy: Feasible plans after geometry filtering, before model admission. Program signatures omit wording, handedness, repetitions, amplitude and timing. Text diversity does not establish motion fidelity.
